scope.summary: Close an ERP hyperscaler parity verification gap by making the executable parity-matrix validator reject criteria without a named benchmark surface.
explicit_non_claims: No ERP platform service, runtime deployment, cloud integration, generated artifact, new dependency, Cargo authority, or production readiness claim is introduced.
No hand edits are made to *.generated.json.
The current red/yellow matrix statuses remain honest gap tracking; this PR only prevents benchmark-surface omissions from validating.

hyperscaler_lens.benchmark: AWS/GCP-class control planes and ERP SaaS administration surfaces require every parity criterion to name its comparator surface before it can be treated as verified or gap-tracked.
hyperscaler_lens.parity_criterion_improved: control-plane API and all other ERP hyperscaler parity facets now fail closed when benchmark_surface is blank.

facets.F1_correctness: validate_erp_hyperscaler_parity_matrix rejects blank benchmark_surface values and returns the facet-specific MissingHyperscalerParityBenchmark error.
facets.F2_tests: Added a regression test that blanks the ControlPlaneApi benchmark_surface and proves the validator fails closed; targeted Buck2 test passed 19 tests.
facets.F3_maintainability: The change reuses the existing parity-matrix validator and error enum instead of adding a new artifact, parser, dependency, or abstraction.
facets.F4_compatibility: Existing valid matrix rows continue to pass; the new error variant is additive within this repo and the dependent cloud-readiness gate still builds and tests green.
facets.F5_security: No credentials, secrets, authorization expansion, runtime input path, or external data flow is introduced.
facets.F6_privacy: No tenant, user, payroll, financial, or personal data processing changes.
facets.F7_operability: Future ERP parity matrix edits now produce a deterministic local and CI-test failure when a comparator benchmark surface is omitted.
facets.F8_performance: Validation adds one trim/is_empty check per matrix criterion; the matrix is static and tiny.
facets.F9_compliance: The PR carries multispectrum and audit-chain evidence, preserves generated-artifact policy, and uses Buck2 as authoritative verification.
facets.F10_reversibility: Rollback is a normal revert of two Rust files, the ADR evidence pointer, and evidence rows; no migration or live state is involved.
facets.F11_observability: Evidence names the exact parity criterion improved, targeted Buck2 commands, code-review verdict, and remaining no-runtime-claim boundary.
facets.F13_migration: Supports the owned-stack migration by keeping ERP parity as a provider-neutral Rust validation contract rather than a prose-only checklist.

review.self_review: Passes hyperscaler architecture review for separation of concerns, provider neutrality, operability, security, and merge-conflict resistance.

verification.evidence: 8 tests passed; local reproduction of the remote cloud-ci-firewall unjustified regression is fixed

known_gaps: Remote oya-ci-required evidence is pending until after push and PR creation.
Reviewer threads and merge status are pending until the PR is opened.
specs/root-hub-pointers.json references /specs/multispectrum-review.json, but that exact spec file is absent in this worktree; existing evidence shape was reused instead.
